ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between high-intensity light-gray lobes (approx. 75% of surface) and low-intensity black central and marginal pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized black pigmentation block radiating from the median notch; distinct dark pixel clusters (mottling) scattered on the upper-mid sections of both lobes; continuous low-intensity band along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, deep V-shaped depression with a distinct central vertex dividing the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous presence of fine-grained, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the horizontal boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a predominantly straight horizontal profile with slight concavity occurring toward the tapered distal tips.
